title: Creating a Sandbox OpenWorld MMORPG - Looking for testers!
author: Kajamaz
selftext:
I'm creating a fantasy Sandbox MMORPG heavily influenced by Runescape, Guild Wars, Albion Online and Ultima Online.

Hoping to find some players interested in trying the game and helping the game eventually contest against the top MMOS!

We're starting to hand out keys through our [Discord](https://discord.gg/EmHQqTCEUv) if you're interest!
